relevance.rationale: Constructs seminormal orthogonal representations of Hecke algebras H_n(q), proves C*-positivity of Markov traces on real-q/unit-circle regimes, and determines the real-q star-structure.

keyResults.statement: Explicit seminormal matrix units for H_n(q) with positive-definite inner product under the real-q C*-involution sigma_i^* = sigma_i and Markov trace decomposition.
keyResults.useForFolio: Directly backs the division-free Wenzl metric M_q, unimodular Cauchy-Green strain det G_{(2,1)}(w) = 1, and global electron minimum Tr G_{(2,1)}(e) = 2 in QOU/StandardModel/LeptonFramedGNSAndStrainOrder.lean.
